pattern: と言われている（といわれている）
purpose: Report a description as something generally said.
keywords: Plain clause + と言われている.
This town is said to be quiet.
This flower is said to bloom in spring.
That bridge is said to have been built a hundred years ago.
formation: Plain clause + と言われている.
restrictions: It attributes a claim to general reporting; it does not establish its truth.
mistake: Distinguish a general report from a specific person’s direct quotation.
